pages.title: Part 1: Foundations - Understanding the Weaving Metaphor
pages.excerpt: Foundational concepts of HoloLoom including weaving metaphor, memory systems, and knowledge graphs

sections.heading: The Weaving Metaphor
sections.content: HoloLoom uses a textile metaphor to describe computation. Warp threads represent independent modules, the shuttle orchestrator coordinates their interaction, and the woven fabric is the complete output with full provenance.

sections.heading: Memory Systems Explained
sections.content: Understanding HoloLoom's three-tier memory architecture: episodic memories for recent interactions, semantic memories for general knowledge, and procedural memories for how to accomplish tasks.

sections.heading: Knowledge Graphs & Relationships
sections.content: Knowledge graphs represent semantic relationships as a network of entities and connections. Learn how HoloLoom uses Yarn Graph for symbolic memory with spectral features.

sections.heading: Thompson Sampling for Exploration
sections.content: Thompson Sampling balances exploration and exploitation in decision-making. Understand the Beta-Bernoulli conjugate pair and how it enables effective tool selection.

sections.heading: Multi-Scale Feature Extraction
sections.content: Matryoshka embeddings provide multi-scale representations where smaller dimensions are prefix-aligned with larger ones, enabling efficient retrieval at different scales.

sections.heading: Execution Modes: BARE, FAST, FUSED

pages.title: 9-Layer Architecture Deep Dive
pages.excerpt: Detailed explanation of each layer in HoloLoom's architecture

sections.heading: Layer 1: Input Adapters (SpinningWheel)
sections.content: Convert raw inputs (audio, text, documents) into standardized MemoryShard objects with metadata and embeddings.

sections.heading: Layer 2: Motif Detection
sections.content: Extract symbolic patterns and motifs from input using regex patterns, spaCy entities, and learned templates.

sections.heading: Layer 3: Embedding Generation
sections.content: Create Matryoshka multi-scale embeddings (96, 192, 384 dimensions) with spectral graph features.

sections.heading: Layer 4: Memory Retrieval
sections.content: Retrieve relevant memories using BM25 keyword search and semantic similarity across multiple scales.

sections.heading: Layer 5: Feature Fusion (Resonance Shed)
sections.content: Combine extracted motifs, embeddings, and spectral features into DotPlasma feature representation.

sections.heading: Layer 6: Policy Engine (Warp Space)
sections.content: Neural policy with Thompson Sampling bandit selects best tool based on features and context.

sections.heading: Layer 7: Tool Execution
sections.content: Execute selected tool and gather results with proper error handling and graceful fallback.

sections.heading: Layer 8: Output Synthesis
sections.content: Synthesize final response from tool results, context, and feedback with full provenance tracking.

sections.heading: Layer 9: Reflection Learning
sections.content: Learn from outcomes through episodic storage, policy updates, and continuous adaptation.

pages.title: Component Reference - Detailed API
pages.excerpt: API reference for all major HoloLoom components

sections.heading: WeavingOrchestrator
sections.content: Main orchestrator coordinating the 9-step weaving cycle. Implements protocol-based design with backward compatibility.

sections.heading: Policy Engine (UnifiedPolicy)
sections.content: Neural decision-making with three bandit exploration strategies: Epsilon-Greedy, Bayesian Blend, and Pure Thompson Sampling.

sections.heading: Memory Systems
sections.content: Unified memory API with pluggable backends: NetworkX (INMEMORY), Neo4j+Qdrant (HYBRID), Hyperspace (HYPERSPACE).

sections.heading: Embedding System
sections.content: Matryoshka embeddings with zero-copy access, multi-scale fusion, and spectral features for efficient retrieval.

sections.heading: Knowledge Graph (Yarn Graph)
sections.content: Entity-relationship graph using NetworkX MultiDiGraph with typed edges and spectral features.

pages.title: API Reference - Complete Function Documentation
pages.excerpt: Complete API reference for HoloLoom

sections.heading: Core API (hololoom.py)
sections.content: Main entry point with three core methods: experience() to form memories, recall() to retrieve memories, reflect() to learn from feedback.

sections.heading: Memory API
sections.content: Memory system interface with methods for storing, retrieving, and searching across embeddings and knowledge graphs.

sections.heading: Policy API
sections.content: Policy engine interface for decision-making with access to bandit statistics, policy weights, and adaptation controls.

sections.heading: RAG API
sections.content: Retrieval-Augmented Generation system with zero-config API supporting text and multimodal queries.

pages.title: Core API - hololoom.py
pages.excerpt: Main HoloLoom entry point API

sections.heading: class HoloLoom
sections.content: Main class providing unified API. Methods: __init__(config), experience(content), recall(query), reflect(memories, feedback), summary(), get_metrics().

sections.heading: experience(content)
sections.content: Form memories from input. Returns Memory object with activation tracking. Supports text, audio, documents.

sections.heading: recall(query)
sections.content: Retrieve memories matching query. Returns list of Memory objects ranked by relevance with confidence scores.

sections.heading: reflect(memories, feedback)
sections.content: Learn from feedback to improve future recalls. Updates awareness graph and policy weights asynchronously.
